text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Duramente—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That plushie— ...I see, so that's how you 
won it.

Duramente was gazing at a crane game 
filled with plushies modelled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Crown's been collecting those lately. 
She's been enthusiastically examining 
them."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Crown takes good care of me all the 
time. I'd like to win one and bring it 
back for her, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I am not well-versed in 
these kinds of games.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like it will be difficult, as 
expected.
choice_data_list: Alright, let me give it a try!
Then I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! I see. Then I shall take that into 
consideration.
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
